items.question: Does the agent reply on its own?
items.answer: Yes. And you choose how much to hand off: it can reply automatically or leave you a draft to approve.

items.question: What happens with my data?
items.answer: We only use it to provide the service and we don't sell it. Read the [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy) or request the [deletion of your data](/data-deletion) whenever you want.

items.question: Which channels does it work with?
items.answer: [WhatsApp Business](/whatsapp), [Instagram](/instagram), [Messenger](/messenger) and [MercadoLibre](/mercadolibre), all with each platform's official access and in a single inbox.

items.question: Is it a good fit for agencies and community managers?
items.answer: Yes. You can set up one agent per client with each business's information and tone. See [BoxLead for agencies](/agencias).

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: With a monthly subscription that includes all your channels.
